# pub title
title: "Robots as Proxies: Negotiating Dignity, Legibility and Accountability in Accessible Social Participation"

# publication image

 alt-text: "A sketch of a scenario where an older adults is sat at a couch and has a remote control connected to a robot that is walking on the street." # provide a short description for the image #a11y

# short description of the publication
description: "We contribute an account of accessibility tensions in robot-mediated social participation, based on Speed Dating interviews with 16 older adults. We show how proxy robots shift from practical extensions for acting at a distance to socially consequential presences, and identify three design directions: legible action, configurable presence, and authority contracts."
